close_reason: Implemented in Jidoka commit 3e18619a. run_sequence no longer owns or injects agent history; each step uses normal Session continuation and promotion. description: Repository: Jidoka. Remove sequence-local conversation ownership and route ordered sequences through the same promotion rules as normal Session calls. Acceptance: sequence and repeated Session calls create the same transcript shape and preserve existing result contracts.
title: Unify run_sequence with Session continuation
